response.sql: WITH rating_prices AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, per_day_price, per_day_price / (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) FROM rating_prices) AS relative_per_day_price FROM rating_prices ORDER BY rating
